place.name: Swiss Reformed Church of Saint-Maurice, Chavornay
place.description: The Swiss Reformed Church of Saint-Maurice (French: église réformée Saint-Maurice), also named Church of Saint Marcel or simply the Chavornay Temple (French: temple de Chavornay), is a Protestant church in the municipality of Chavornay, Vaud, Switzerland. It is a parish church of the Evangelical Reformed Church of the Canton of Vaud.
